text: Blockchain platforms for fund formation lower start up and compliance costs, which especially enables new and future managers to enter the market rather than merely benefiting existing managers.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Innovation for Private Investment Funds (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2998033

isBasedOn.name: Blockchain Innovation for Private Investment Funds

abstract: the lower operating costs enabled by the platform models will especially enable new and future managers to enter the market because the start-up costs and compliance costs can be significantly reduced.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: applies to platform models such as Melonport and Drago
